frames.text: The records list {name} as {level}. They do not list mercy.
{name} is filed under {type}. Files are tidy; living data is not.
Anyone can look up {name}'s moves. Nobody can look up its reasons.
Level says {level}; type says {type}. Neither says what {name} wants.
If the records call {name} a {type}, the records have not met it.
{name}'s file lists {move}. A move is a fact, not a promise.
A {level} like {name} still gets to choose. Rank is not character.
Every {type} carries data differently. {name} is no exception.
The records put {name} at {level}. I put no one at a level twice.
{name} is {level}. That is the whole file; the rest is choices.
